headline: Will he come back?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). 🔴 NO FORECAST IN EITHER DIRECTION — 'he will come back' and 'he has moved on' are both things no card knows, and the second is the one that sounds like honesty. 🔴 Never blame her for waiting: naive, too trusting, foolish, clinging, desperate and 'wasted your time' are all banned outright. 🔴 No timeframe, no guarantee.

⚠️ SHARES ITS HEADLINE WITH cards-return ON PURPOSE — the two are a deliberate A/B on the same ad question, so this read has to be genuinely its own or the comparison is dead. cards-return's finding is that he is not short of a way back and the pull is not only hers; this one takes the DOOR SHE HAS BEEN HOLDING — the waiting is a job she has been doing alone with no one to relieve her.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the roses above him are wide open, not in bud.
You asked about him coming back. Your hand went to the man who does the doing.
So this hasn't closed, dear. The door you've held is still open.
And it's one person doing all the holding, dear. Look at him.
But holding a door open takes it out of you, dear. Every day.
That's why you're worn thin, dear. Nobody offered to take a turn.
Let me look closer at what has been wedged in that doorway…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the crossbar sits just above his tied foot.
You asked about him coming back. Your hand went to the card that neither opens nor shuts.
So the door has neither opened nor shut, dear. It just hangs there.
And he's fixed in place, dear, with no news arriving either way.
But you've been standing in the same spot with it, dear.
That's why the wait sits so heavy on you, dear. It has just been long.
Let me look closer at what has kept this fixed so long…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his cap has a feather and a small green sprig.
You asked about him coming back. Your hand went to the one who keeps moving.
So you kept your life going, dear. You have not stopped.
And he's loaded up, dear, and still putting one foot out.
But the card won't say who walks towards whom, dear.
That's why the road keeps pulling your eye, dear. You've done the walking.
Let me look closer at what has been slowing the road between you…
